arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = xl.parse(name, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ---")
    print(df.to_string())

import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
print(xml)

from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = 'budget.xlsx'
wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)    # cached values
wbf = load_workbook(path, data_only=False)  # formulas

for ws, wsf in zip(wb.worksheets, wbf.worksheets):
    print(f"=== Sheet: {ws.title} (dims {ws.dimensions}) ===")
    rows_data = []
    for row, rowf in zip(ws.iter_rows(), wsf.iter_rows()):
        vals = [c.value for c in row]
        formulas = [c.value for c in rowf]
        if any(v is not None for v in vals):
            rows_data.append((row[0].coordinate, vals, formulas))
    for coord, vals, formulas in rows_data:
        nums = [v for v in vals if isinstance(v, (int, float))]
        has_formula = [f for f in formulas if isinstance(f, str) and f.startswith('=')]
        print(coord, vals, "| row_sum:", round(sum(nums), 2), "| formulas:", has_formula)
    allnums = [v for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row for v in [c.value] if isinstance(v, (int, float))]
    print("SHEET TOTAL (all numeric):", round(sum(allnums), 2))
    print()
